curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how health and short illnesses affect driving, why a brief nod-off is dangerous, where drowsy crashes happen, the warning signs, and what to do: stop, short fixes, regular breaks and daily mileage.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card separating the temporary nap and caffeine fix from routine breaks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a tired driver and asking the right response.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define distraction, list common distractions, show how they slow reactions and take a hand off the wheel, then the safe phone habits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per idea and habit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what counts as distraction and safer phone habits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the texting and email ban for all drivers, the total phone ban under eighteen, the school bus ban, and separate the laws from the safety advice.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each law; contrast cards for all drivers versus under eighteen and law versus advice.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver's phone use and asking whether it is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover medicines and driving, the share of deaths involving alcohol, how alcohol slows the brain and judgment, that only time sobers, and ways to avoid drinking and driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per effect and tip; a contrast card on sobering myths.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on alcohol's effects and sobering myths.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with lifetime crash odds, then the seat belt law for driver and passengers, air bags and lap belts, and the listed exemptions with the twenty mile per hour delivery limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the law and each exemption; contrast cards on the lap belt and the delivery speed limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an occupant and asking whether a belt is required.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why child seats matter, choosing one, the under-sixteen rule, the under-eight weight rule, the rear-seat air bag rule, the lap-belt exception, and booster fit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the age and weight pairs and the lap-belt exception.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a child and a car and asking the restraint rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show the force of an air bag, where children should ride, belt position and seat distance, then motorcycle helmets and the DOT symbol, and the pickup bed rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for advice versus law ages and symbol versus sticker.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on seating children, belt fit, helmets and pickup beds.
